name: f6ev_pseudo2025
_doc: configs/f6_final.json (f5 + the grade-A events layer) on 2025 Jan/Feb/Jun/Jul with month-out members, as f5_pseudo2025.json. The events layer is refitted per held month on f5's own rehearsal rows of the other three months (f5_pseudo2025_{mode}.parquet, col post4_recovered, the prediction entering the layer); the layer checks that the held month's entering values equal that column.

prc-f-x5._note: x5 pinned to xgboost 2.1.4: prc-f-x5-mo/output/oof.csv holds all four folds (M1/M6 from that run, M2/M7 copied from prc-f-x5p-mo; identical values checked). The xgboost 3.4.1 runs were renamed prc-f-x5-xgb341 / prc-f-x5-mo-xgb341 and are not used.
